Why Canvas Resets & How to Save Permanently

Database & Permanent Storage

The chat preview runs in a temporary sandbox that wipes browser memory when closed. Use any of these 3 built-in ways to keep your selected day and weights permanently:

1. Bake Weights Into Your Own App File (No Server Needed)

Saves your current day (e.g. Thursday), weights, reps, and shopping list directly inside the HTML code and downloads a fresh file to your phone.

2. Supabase for Vercel Database (Auto-Syncs Every Tap) Auto-Detects on Vercel

When deployed on Vercel with Supabase connected in your Vercel Storage tab, the included /api/state route auto-saves every tap! Just run the 1-line SQL table command below in Supabase once:

Smartwatch Alerts & Health

Samsung Galaxy Watch • Apple Watch • Garmin

ACTIVE: Watch Alerts Enabled via Phone OS (Samsung Galaxy Watch / Apple Watch / Garmin)
Notifications are blocked by Chrome. Tap the 3-dot menu (top right) -> Site controls -> Permissions -> Allow Notifications.
Lock your phone screen now — vibrating watch in 5s...
Samsung Galaxy Watch Checklist
  • 1. Galaxy Wearable app on phone -> Watch settings -> Notifications -> App notifications -> Turn ON BudgetGym & Chrome.
  • 2. Galaxy Wearable -> Notifications -> Show phone notifications on watch -> Select "Show alerts even while using phone".
  • 3. If you reinstalled the app to update the GYM icon, toggle BudgetGym ON in Galaxy Wearable.
